# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt

Compare bounded child-route delegation with post-session branch analysis when the parent route already has an anchor, named child outputs, and a need for one local reviewer child.

## Expected selection

use

## Why

The request already has the parent anchor and child outputs needed for a single
bounded child route, so the next move is lane, gate, return, and closeout
planning rather than branch-card analysis.

## Expected object

A summon decision with lane, gates, and explicit return planning for one bounded child route.

## Boundary notes

This is a summon case, not a session-route-forks case.

## Verification hooks

- confirm the parent anchor and named child outputs exist
- name the chosen child lane and gates
- keep return and closeout mapping explicit
